name: NSE Options Anomaly Detection and Alert Workflow with n8n, Supabase, Google Sheets, OpenAI and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Snapshot Persistence

This section preserves the detected option snapshot in Supabase and sends anomalous contracts to OpenAI for interpretation. The AI explains the unusual activity and discusses possible bullish, bearish, hedging, or event driven explanations without treating the anomaly as confirmed smart money activity.

## Market Scan Scheduling

This section starts the NSE options monitoring workflow on the configured schedule. It reads the symbols and scanning configuration from Google Sheets and filters the watchlist to include only enabled instruments before preparing clean symbol data for the options data request.

## Historical Data Analysis

This section compares the latest option activity against historical information stored in Supabase. Volume ratios, open interest ratios, and statistical z scores are calculated for each contract. Contracts meeting the configured anomaly conditions are then separated for deeper processing

## Option Data Collection
This section retrieves option chain data from the configured NSE data endpoint. The returned contracts are then converted into a consistent structure containing expiry, strike, option type, price, volume, open interest, implied volatility, and underlying price for further analysis.

## Anomaly Reporting and Email Notification
This section stores AI enhanced anomaly results in Supabase, logs all detected contracts in Google Sheets, and combines them into a single email digest. The final Gmail alert includes complete anomaly details, statistical metrics, AI interpretation, and risk information.

# NSE Options Anomaly Detection and Alert Workflow
## How Workflow Works

The workflow automatically monitors NSE option contracts according to the configured schedule and watchlist. It first reads enabled symbols from Google Sheets and fetches their option chain data through the configured data endpoint. The returned contracts are normalized and compared against historical option data stored in Supabase. The workflow calculates volume ratios, open interest ratios, and z scores before filtering contracts that meet the anomaly conditions. Detected anomalies are stored as snapshots, analyzed by OpenAI, and saved with their AI interpretation in Supabase. The same anomaly records are logged into Google Sheets for reporting and tracking. Finally, all anomalies from the execution are combined into one Gmail digest containing the complete contract information and AI analysis.

## Setup Steps

Configure the Google Sheets watchlist with symbols, exchange, scan mode, strike count, and enabled status.
Configure the option chain HTTP endpoint and ensure it returns the expected NSE option contract fields.
Create and configure the Supabase option snapshot and anomaly tables and connect the Supabase credentials.
Configure the anomaly calculation thresholds and historical comparison logic according to your monitoring requirements.
Connect the OpenAI, Google Sheets, Supabase, and Gmail credentials and verify that anomaly records are saved correctly.
Set the scanner schedule, execute a test run, verify the Supabase and Google Sheets records, and confirm that all detected anomalies arrive in one Gmail digest.
